Replace the default MarkdownToHtmlConverter with our MarkdownRdfaConverter. The Override changes the @type of the existing instance (keeping its @id so the ChainedConverter's converters list still references it) and swaps the templateEngine parameter for our podBase + storagePath parameters. podBase is the server baseUrl variable (NOT a literal — R-T2 / D107: the resolver mints wikilink hrefs under podBase+storagePath+/wiki/ and that root must follow the deployment), storagePath defaults to /vault. Our converter emits a complete HTML document itself — no CSS template wrapping.
Add ldp:constrainedBy to the existing LinkRel metadata writer so it appears as a Link header.

Insert the AdmissionFloorStore (D108 Front-2) BELOW MonitoringStore. Resolved chain (top→bottom): MonitoringStore → BinarySlice → Index → Locking → PatchingStore → AdmissionFloor → ShapeValidationStore → Converting → backend. The floor must sit below MonitoringStore so a rejected POST (which commits-then-rolls-back internally) emits no 'changed' events — no orphaned .meta/Memento/event residue (Task 7 review).

D108 Front-2 admission floor. Gates writes to ldp:constrainedBy containers: projects a non-RDF body to its candidate .meta graph, SHACL-validates THAT against the container shape, rejects non-conforming writes with a 422 (ShaclValidationError → Turtle report), and on success materializes the admitted graph + a body-hash stamp in-band (RQ-Enforce-1). RDF bodies pass through to the ShapeValidationStore below. The projector param has a wildcard range (constructor typed `unknown`, mirrors ShaclValidator.unprocessableHook) so the structurally-compatible MarkdownBodyProjector from the markdown-projection bundle injects across bundles.
Default no-op hook for ShaclValidator. Swapped for MemTriggerUnprocessableWriteHook by mem-trigger.json Override when mem-trigger is installed.
Validates resources when parent container has ldp:constrainedBy in its metadata. Also enforces D99 Layer 2 path-based class disjointness via pathConstraints.

ShaclErrorHandler intercepts ShaclValidationError (thrown by ShaclValidator on non-conformance) and returns 422 with Content-Type: text/turtle body containing the sh:ValidationReport. Inserted before ConvertingErrorHandler so agents can self-correct from parseable RDF instead of opaque JSON. Falls through (NotImplementedHttpError) for all other error types.
